title: White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard

[[White Mantle Wrath: A Helping Hand]] }} The [[White Mantle]], angered by the death of [[Justiciar Hablion]], are moving against the [[Shining Blade]]. The [[White Mantle]] forces preparing to attack [[Quarrel Falls]] must be stopped, and [[Councilor Vaylor]] must be warned of the danger. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Destroy the three groups of [[White Mantle]] vanguard marching to [[Quarrel Falls]]. * See [[Councilor Vaylor]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 500 [[Experience]] * 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * Cane ** [[Chaos damage|Chaos Dmg]]: 9-16 (Requires 5 [[Domination Magic]])
[[Health]] +10
Health +10 (while [[Hex spell|Hexed]])
Health +10 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]]) ==Walkthrough== This quest is quite straightforward: walk into [[Silverwood]] and kill the three groups of [[White Mantle]] located where the quest markers indicate. Each group consists of two [[White Mantle Knight]]s and a [[White Mantle Sycophant]]. The final group is located very close to the entrance to [[Ettin's Back]]. Dispatch them and then head into [[Ettin's Back]] to locate [[Councilor Vaylor]] for the reward. Councilor Vaylor is located right outside the entrance to [[Ventari's Refuge]]. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Human]]s ([[White Mantle]]) *{{w}} 16 (25) [[White Mantle Knight]] *{{me}} 16 (25) [[White Mantle Sycophant]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Gareth Quickblade''' :''"We have been betrayed by one of our own! A traitor has given away the locations of the [[Shining Blade]]'s bases throughout the region. In response to Hablion's death, they are launching a massive strike led by the [[Demagogue]].'' :''Scouts have reported a vanguard comprising three groups; they're currently pushing towards [[Quarrel Falls]]. We must warn [[Councilor Vaylor]] outside of [[Ventari's Refuge]]. I need you to head them off and buy us some time."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'll do it! | decline = Do it yourself. | ask = Head south and eliminate all three White Mantle groups. }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''Councilor Vaylor''' :''"You have bought us time, hero. Your deeds today will not be forgotten, and you certainly won't go unrewarded by the Shining Blade. We are grateful for your assistance.'' :''Gareth's support will be here shortly."'' ==Notes== * The Cane awarded has the [[Deadly Cesta]] skin. The stats on that wand cannot be replicated, since there are no [[Wand Wrapping]]s nor [[Inscription]]s that increase maximum health. * Additional White Mantle groups will spawn in [[Ettin's Back]], but they are likely to be attacked by Centaurs, and do not have to be fought for the quest. {{anomaly|This quest may be taken prematurely if the player follows the quests [[Mysterious Message (Prophecies quest)|Mysterious Message]] and [[The Price of Steel]] to Quarrel Falls. In doing so, the player could miss the storyline of [[The Wilds]] and [[Bloodstone Fen]], which precedes White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard, as indicated by the quest's dialogue.}} {{bug|There's a chance of [[Centaur]]s spawning and attacking the last group of White Mantle. If they kill any White Mantle before the player, the quest might not update, forcing the player to restart from Quarrel Falls.}} [[Category:Quests that award unreplicable items]]
